methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
OSH Cut is a bootstrapped robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb and Jacom Chamberlain. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. While eight same-sector comparables exist, none satisfy the filtering criteria for stage, timing proximity, or valuation tier alignment required for robust median triangulation. Specifically, zero bootstrapped-stage or adjacent-stage peers with similar characteristics were identified. The data set does not meet the minimum threshold of three narrow-filter datapoints necessary to derive a defensible peer multiple.

Without sufficient same-stage or near-stage private comps and given the limited data on the single public comparable, traditional triangulation methods cannot be reliably applied. A full valuation would require either: expansion of stage-appropriate comparable data, access to transaction multiples for recent robotics fundraises, or income-based methods tied to OSH Cut's specific unit economics and growth trajectory. The key uncertainty is OSH Cut's revenue scale and growth rate relative to the identified peer set, which would be necessary to weight any public or private multiples meaningfully.
